name: @hiero-hackers/automation-lab
description: The standing instrument for facts about GitHub's behaviour that only contact with GitHub can verify. Tests verify our code; the lab verifies our beliefs about someone else's system. Protocols are the methods, src/ holds one thin runner per question, conclusions migrate to design/ (D32). Era-1 harness, bulk evidence, and credentials are local-only — see .gitignore and README.md.
